structured.answer: I'd go with Harel's "מניות" track in the קופת גמל להשקעה: it went up the most (24.04% over 3 years, 14.64% over 5) and the fee is only about 0.55%, same as the rest. But the page doesn't tell me how to actually put the money in, so I'm stuck there.
